irregularities.title: Roster index pruned 27 record(s) no current source supports
irregularities.detail: The player index is pruned each run: a (club, player) record is dropped when the official report names the player under a different club and no current source still asserts it, or when no source has asserted it for 14 days. Dropped this run: BAL:teddye-buchanan (official report lists the player under a different club); BAL:matthew-hibner (official report lists the player under a different club); JAX:tanner-koziol (not asserted by any source for 14.1 days); JAX:nate-boerkircher (official report lists the player under a different club); LAR:davis-allen (official report lists the player under a different club); NO:colby-wooden (official report lists the player under a different club); TB:elijah-simmons (not asserted by any source for 14.1 days); JAX:bj-green (not asserted by any source for 14.1 days); HOU:henry-to-oto-o (not asserted by any source for 14.1 days); LAR:omar-speights (official report lists the player under a different club); PIT:tj-watt (official report lists the player under a different club); PIT:cameron-heyward (official report lists the player under a different club); LV:dareke-young (official report lists the player under a different club); CAR:claudin-cherelus (not asserted by any source for 14.1 days); WAS:brandon-coleman (not asserted by any source for 14.1 days); HOU:jared-wayne (not asserted by any source for 14.1 days); WAS:colson-yankoff (not asserted by any source for 14.1 days); LV:foley-fatukasi (official report lists the player under a different club); LV:segun-olubi (official report lists the player under a different club); CAR:thomas-incoom (official report lists the player under a different club) (+7 more). This is the guard against stale records mis-attributing in-game events (see the 2026-09-16 HOU/GB misattribution in the README verification log).

irregularities.title: Beat writer Daniel Oyefusi is attributed across 2 clubs (NYJ, CLE)
irregularities.detail: ESPN printed Daniel Oyefusi (ESPN.com) as the attribution on updates for multiple clubs. Local beat writers normally cover one club, so this is usually a shared-wire/aggregator attribution; it is kept as observed and flagged for manual review rather than reassigned by guesswork.

Alerts can only be as timely as this number: see the cadence panel on the site, which is fed from the same measurement.
